thread:
maria.g: Quick handoff — I'm leaving in ~10. Pool east-1 GPU looks healthy but watch for small latency blips. We've seen a steady uptick from tenant `vectorflow` since 18:00; bumped their burst_limit to 2x for now. Check the queue if you see growth.
ken_p: thanks — what's current queue length and avg wait?
maria.g: ~14 pending across two jobs, avg wait ~230ms. No OOMs. KV cache hit rate ~78% (measured at 19:38).
arun_k: FYI there is a scheduled model rollout to prod-canary at 21:00 that could spike short-term traffic (internal canary test). I set a soft cap on that pool at 60% to avoid noisy neighbor bursts.
sam_t: can we preemptively move a node from dry-pool to east-1? I can do a manual swap around 21:05 if needed.
maria.g: I can stay on the pager until 21:30 — ping me if you plan the swap. If p50 latency >350ms escalate to ken.
oncall-bot: Alert: pool-east-1-gpu usage crossed 70% at 19:42 (sustained 3m). No automated action triggered.
devon_l: Heads-up: analytics scheduled an embedding batch at 20:30; I asked them to cap concurrency to 4 and to use lower-priority queue.
ken_p: if queue >25 then plan: 1) add +1 node to pool, 2) enable fallback-model-1 for low-priority tenants, 3) notify affected customers. Keep me posted.
maria.g: noted. runbook link: https://go/re/rw-inference/runbooks/capacity (see steps under "short bursts").
sam_t: small note — spin-up of a node can take ~90s for the first ready container; autoscaler sometimes lags by ~20s. Account for that when deciding to add nodes.
arun_k: I removed an old quota override earlier today — double-check the quota-controller policies before scaling so we don't hit tenant caps.
ken_p: also if KV cache hit drops <60% for >5m consider disabling prefix-cache for vectorflow jobs; it's been causing thrash in the past.
maria.g: leaving a short ops note in ops-notes as well. I exported the relevant metrics graph (KV hit, queue length, p50 latency) to the handoff.
sam_t: taking this over. I'll post an update in 15m and again around 21:15 after the canary window.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded by maria.g at 1847654321."
